rpcRequests: Maps to PilotRpc.newUnits, i.e. accounted operation units. This projection alone does not prove physical invocation/provider delivery for each unit; proven-uninvoked reservations are being independently investigated. Keep exact reported values, label their scope accurately.
rpcResponseBytes: Maps to PilotRpc.newAccountedResponseBytes, including HTTP/control-WebSocket accounting. Not exclusively HTTP body bytes; do not add to nativeStreamBytes.
holdingRpcNotes: Separate source-owned calls, logical attempts, dispatch refusals, owned starts and failure stages. Acquisition counts are not completed protection evaluations.
evidenceRule: No original snapshots or historical counters are replaced. These notes clarify analytical wording; actual kernel cgroup I/O and host-network measurements remain separate.
